summary: Entergy Corporation filed an 8-K to disclose entry into forward sale agreements and an underwriting agreement for a public offering of 19,247,788 shares of common stock (with an option for up to 2,887,168 additional shares). The offering closed on May 7, 2026. The forward sale agreements have an initial forward sale price of $110.74 per share and allow for settlement at Entergy's discretion until April 30, 2028. This is a routine equity offering and forward sale transaction, not a special situation; there is no change of control, acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review.
